/*********************************************************************/
/* Header files                                                      */
/*********************************************************************/

#include <sys/types.h>                /* common typedefs             */
#include <sys/uio.h>                  /* IOV_MAX, struct iovec       */
#include <unistd.h>                   /* getdomainname, setdomainname,
                                         gethostid, sethostid,
                                         gethostname, sethostname,
                                         function prototypes         */
#include <inttypes.h>                 /* integral typedefs       @A6A*/


#if (__OS400_TGTVRM__>=510)  /* @B1A*/
#pragma datamodel(P128)      /* @B1A*/
#endif                       /* @B1A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros to denote address families                                 */
/*********************************************************************/

#define AF_UNSPEC      0              /* Unspecified             @A7A*/
#define AF_UNIX        1              /* UNIX (local) domain         */
#define AF_INET        2              /* Internet domain             */
#define AF_NS          6              /* Network Services domain     */
#define AF_INET6      24              /* IPv6                    @A7A*/
#define AF_UNIX_CCSID 98              /* UNIX with CCSID support @A5A*/
#define AF_TELEPHONY  99              /* Telephony domain        @A4A*/


/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros to denote type of a socket                                 */
/*********************************************************************/

#define SOCK_STREAM    1              /* stream                      */
#define SOCK_DGRAM     2              /* datagram                    */
#define SOCK_RAW       3              /* raw                         */
#define SOCK_SEQPACKET 5              /* sequential packet           */


/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros to denote protocol families                                */
/*********************************************************************/

#define PF_UNSPEC      AF_UNSPEC      /* Unspecified             @A7A*/
#define PF_INET        AF_INET        /* Internet domain             */
#define PF_INET6       AF_INET6       /* Internet domain         @A7A*/
#define PF_UNIX        AF_UNIX        /* UNIX (local) domain         */
#define PF_NS          AF_NS          /* Network Services domain     */
#define PF_UNIX_CCSID  AF_UNIX_CCSID  /* UNIX with CCSID support @A5A*/
#define PF_TELEPHONY   AF_TELEPHONY   /* Telephony domain        @A4A*/


/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros for socket level options (via setsockopt() & getsockopt()) */
/*********************************************************************/

#define SO_BROADCAST   5              /* allow broadcast messages    */
#define SO_ACCEPTECONNABORTED   6     /* return ECONNABORTED from
                                         accept (IBM only)      @A7A */
#define SO_ACCEPTEPERM  7             /* return EPERM in
                                         accept (IBM only)      @ABA */
#define SO_DEBUG       10             /* record debugging information*/
#define SO_DONTROUTE   15             /* just use interface addresses*/
#define SO_ERROR       20             /* socket error status         */
#define SO_KEEPALIVE   25             /* connections are kept alive
                                         with periodic messages      */
#define SO_LINGER      30             /* socket lingers on close     */
#define SO_OOBINLINE   35             /* out-of-band data is
                                         received in-line            */
#define SO_RCVBUF      40             /* receive buffer size         */
#define SO_RCVLOWAT    45             /* receive low water mark      */
#define SO_RCVTIMEO    50             /* receive timeout value       */
#define SO_REUSEADDR   55             /* allow local address reuse   */
#define SO_SNDBUF      60             /* send buffer size            */
#define SO_SNDLOWAT    65             /* send low water mark         */
#define SO_SNDTIMEO    70             /* send timeout value          */
#define SO_TYPE        75             /* socket type                 */
#define SO_USELOOPBACK 80             /* sender receives a copy
                                         of each message that is
                                         transmitted                 */
#define SO_ACCEPTCONN  85             /* socket has had listen() @A6A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros to be used for the flag parameter of input/output routines */
/*********************************************************************/

#define MSG_DONTROUTE  0x0001         /* do not route off the
                                         physical network            */
#define MSG_OOB        0x0004         /* out-of-band data            */
#define MSG_PEEK       0x0008         /* do not destroy the message
                                         on reading (give a copy)    */
#define MSG_TRUNC      0x0010         /* data discarded before
                                         delivery                @A6A*/
#define MSG_CTRUNC     0x0020         /* control data lost before
                                         delivery                @A6A*/
#define MSG_WAITALL    0x0040         /* wait for full request or
                                         error                   @A6A*/
#define MSG_EOR        0x0080         /* data completes record   @A6A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Miscellaneous macros                                              */
/*********************************************************************/

#define MSG_MAXIOVLEN  IOV_MAX        /* maximum number of iovec
                                         structures that may be used
                                         on any socket function      */
#define SOL_SOCKET     -1             /* socket level option         */
#define SOMAXCONN      512            /* maximum number of queued
                                         connection requests         */

/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros to be used for the flag parameter on send_file()       @A3A*/
/*********************************************************************/

#define SF_CLOSE        1             /* Close down the socket
                                         connection              @A3A*/
#define SF_REUSE        2             /* Close down the socket
                                         connection and allow the
                                         socket to be reused     @A3A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros to be used for the how parameter on shutdown()         @A6A*/
/*********************************************************************/
#define SHUT_RD         0       /* shut down for reading         @A6A*/
#define SHUT_WR         1       /* shut down for writing         @A6A*/
#define SHUT_RDWR       2       /* shut down for read & write    @A6A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Structures                                                        */
/*********************************************************************/

struct linger {                       /* linger                      */

   int            l_onoff;            /* option setting - on/off     */
   int            l_linger;           /* time to linger - seconds    */

};

/* Start changes for _XOPEN_SOURCE                               @A6A*/

#ifndef _SOCKLEN_T
  typedef int socklen_t;
  #define _SOCKLEN_T
#endif

#if ((_XOPEN_SOURCE+1>520) && !defined(COMPAT_43))
/* _XOPEN_SOURCE is defined to be >= 520 & not BSD 4.3 compatibility */

#ifndef _SA_FAMILY_T
  typedef uchar sa_family_t;
  #define _SA_FAMILY_T
#endif

/* Define a structure large enough and aligned for any socket address*/

#define _SS_MAXSIZE 304               /* AF_UNIX_CCSID is 304 bytes  */
#define _SS_ALIGNSIZE (sizeof (char*))/* and requires char* alignment*/

#define _SS_PAD1SIZE (_SS_ALIGNSIZE - \
                     (sizeof(uint8_t) + sizeof(sa_family_t)))
#define _SS_PAD2SIZE (_SS_MAXSIZE - (sizeof(uint8_t) + \
                      sizeof(sa_family_t) + \
                      _SS_PAD1SIZE + _SS_ALIGNSIZE))

struct sockaddr_storage {
     uint8_t       ss_len;
     sa_family_t   ss_family;
     char         _ss_pad1[_SS_PAD1SIZE];
     char*        _ss_align;
     char         _ss_pad2[_SS_PAD2SIZE];
 };

struct sockaddr {                     /* generic socket address      */

    uint8_t       sa_len;             /* address length              */
    sa_family_t   sa_family;          /* address family              */
    char          sa_data[14];        /* address                     */

};

struct msghdr {                       /* message header              */

   void         * msg_name;           /* address                     */
   socklen_t      msg_namelen;        /* address length              */
   struct iovec * msg_iov;            /* buffer array                */
   int            msg_iovlen;         /* number of elements in
                                         buffer array                */
   void         * msg_control;        /* ancillary data, see below   */
   socklen_t      msg_controllen;     /* ancillary data buffer len   */
   int            msg_flags;          /* flags on received message   */

};

/* Header for ancillary data objects in msg_control buffer.          */
/* The format is a sequence of message elements headed by            */
/* cmsghdr structures.                                               */

struct cmsghdr {
   socklen_t  cmsg_len;            /* len of this header + data      */
   int     cmsg_level;             /* originating protocol           */
   int     cmsg_type;              /* protocol-specific type         */
};

/* Given a pointer to a struct cmsghdr, return a pointer to the data.*/
#define CMSG_DATA(cmsg) ((uchar *)(((struct cmsghdr *)cmsg) + 1))

/* Align a length to a struct cmsghdr boundary (int boundary).      */
#define _CMSG_ALIGN(p) (((uint)(p) + (sizeof(int) - 1))\
                         &~ (sizeof(int) - 1))

/* Given a pointer to a struct msghdr and its                        */
/*  ancillary data (cmsghdr), return the next cmsghdr or NULL.       */
/* The returned cmsghdr will not be truncated but the user still must*/
/*  verify that the data is within msg_controllen                    */
#define CMSG_NXTHDR(mhdr, cmsg) \
(((cmsg) == NULL) ? ((struct cmsghdr *)(mhdr)->msg_control) : \
    (((caddr_t)(cmsg) + _CMSG_ALIGN((cmsg)->cmsg_len) + \
      sizeof(struct cmsghdr)) > \
     ((caddr_t)((mhdr)->msg_control) + (mhdr)->msg_controllen)) ? \
    (struct cmsghdr *) NULL : (struct cmsghdr *)((caddr_t)(cmsg) + \
                              _CMSG_ALIGN((cmsg)->cmsg_len)))/* @AAC */


/* Given a pointer to a struct msghdr return the first struct cmsghdr*/
#define CMSG_FIRSTHDR(mhdr) ((struct cmsghdr *)(mhdr)->msg_control)

/* Given the length of the ancillary data return how much space needs
to be allocated for the data to satisfy boundary alignments.    @A9A */
#define CMSG_SPACE(length) (sizeof(struct cmsghdr) + \
                            _CMSG_ALIGN(length))             /* @A9A */

/* Given the length of the ancillary data return the value to store in
the cmsg_len member of the cmsghdr structure.                   @A9A */
#define CMSG_LEN(length) (sizeof(struct cmsghdr) + length )  /* @A9A */


/* "Socket"-level control message types:                             */
#define SCM_RIGHTS      0x01            /* access rights             */

#else
/* _XOPEN_SOURCE is not defined to be >= 520 or BSD 4.3 compatibility*/

#ifndef _SA_FAMILY_T
  typedef unsigned short sa_family_t;
  #define _SA_FAMILY_T
#endif

#define _SS_MAXSIZE 304              /* AF_UNIX_CCSID is 304 bytes  */
#define _SS_ALIGNSIZE (sizeof(char*))/* and requires char* alignment*/

#define _SS_PAD1SIZE (_SS_ALIGNSIZE - sizeof(sa_family_t))
#define _SS_PAD2SIZE (_SS_MAXSIZE - (sizeof(sa_family_t) + \
                      _SS_PAD1SIZE + _SS_ALIGNSIZE))

struct sockaddr_storage {
     sa_family_t   ss_family;
     char         _ss_pad1[_SS_PAD1SIZE];
     char*        _ss_align;
     char         _ss_pad2[_SS_PAD2SIZE];
 };

struct sockaddr {                     /* generic socket address      */

    u_short       sa_family;          /* address family              */
    char          sa_data[14];        /* address                     */

};

struct msghdr {                       /* message header              */

   caddr_t        msg_name;           /* address                     */
   int            msg_namelen;        /* address length              */
   struct iovec * msg_iov;            /* buffer array                */
   int            msg_iovlen;         /* number of elements in
                                         buffer array                */
   caddr_t        msg_accrights;      /* access rights               */
   int            msg_accrightslen;   /* access rights length        */

};

#endif
/* End changes for _XOPEN_SOURCE                                 @A6A*/

struct sf_parms {                     /* send_file() parameters  @A3A*/

#ifndef _LARGE_FILES                                           /*@A4A*/
   void          *header_data;        /* header buffer           @A3A*/
   size_t         header_length;      /* length of header        @A3A*/
                                      /*                         @A3A*/
   int            file_descriptor;    /* file descriptor         @A3A*/
   size_t         file_size;          /* length of the file      @A3A*/
   off_t          file_offset;        /* offset into the file    @A3A*/
   ssize_t        file_bytes;         /* number bytes to send    @A3A*/
                                      /* from the file           @A3A*/
                                      /*                         @A3A*/
   void          *trailer_data;       /* trailer buffer          @A3A*/
   size_t         trailer_length;     /* length of trailer       @A3A*/
                                      /*                         @A3A*/
   size_t         bytes_sent;         /* number of bytes sent    @A3A*/

#else  /* Map sf_parms to sf_parms64 structure                   @A4A*/

   void              *header_data;     /* header buffer          @A4A*/
   size_t             header_length;   /* length of header       @A4A*/
                                       /*                        @A4A*/
   int                file_descriptor; /* file descriptor        @A4A*/
   unsigned long long file_size;       /* length of the file     @A4A*/
   long long          file_offset;     /* offset into the file   @A4A*/
   long long          file_bytes;      /* number bytes to send   @A4A*/
                                       /* from the file          @A4A*/
                                       /*                        @A4A*/
   void              *trailer_data;    /* trailer buffer         @A4A*/
   size_t             trailer_length;  /* length of trailer      @A4A*/
                                       /*                        @A4A*/
   unsigned long long bytes_sent;      /* number of bytes sent   @A4A*/
#endif                                 /*                        @A4A*/
};                                     /*                        @A3A*/

/*********************************************************************/

   void              *header_data;     /* header buffer          @A4A*/
   size_t             header_length;   /* length of header       @A4A*/
                                       /*                        @A4A*/
   int                file_descriptor; /* file descriptor        @A4A*/
   unsigned long long file_size;       /* length of the file     @A4A*/
   long long          file_offset;     /* offset into the file   @A4A*/
   long long          file_bytes;      /* number bytes to send   @A4A*/
                                       /* from the file          @A4A*/
                                       /*                        @A4A*/
   void              *trailer_data;    /* trailer buffer         @A4A*/
   size_t             trailer_length;  /* length of trailer      @A4A*/

};                                     /*                        @A4A*/
#endif                                 /*                        @A4A*/

QBFC_EXTERN int    listen(int, int);

                            struct sockaddr *, int *);
QBFC_EXTERN int    recvmsg(int, struct msghdr *, int);
QBFC_EXTERN int    send(int, char *, int, int);
QBFC_EXTERN int    sendmsg(int, struct msghdr *, int);

                          struct sockaddr *, int);

QBFC_EXTERN int    shutdown(int, int);

QBFC_EXTERN int    socketpair(int, int, int, int *);

#endif
/* End changes for _XOPEN_SOURCE                                 @A6A*/

QBFC_EXTERN int    givedescriptor(int, char *);
